jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT US:

AI needs a new infrastructure layer. We're building it at Modal.

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.

Our customers include category-defining companies like Lovable https://modal.com/blog/lovable-case-study, Ramp https://modal.com/blog/how-ramp-built-a-full-context-background-coding-agent-on-modal, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale.

We recently raised a $355M Series C https://modal.com/blog/modal-series-c at a $4.65B valuation, led by General Catalyst and Redpoint Ventures. We've crossed $300M+ ARR and grown fivefold since September.

Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g.,Seaborn https://github.com/mwaskom/seaborn,Luigi https://github.com/spotify/luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience.




THE ROLE:

We’re looking for business operations managers to join the team. This person will work closely with folks across marketing, sales, operations, and finance across a variety of initiatives to help scale the business in our next phase of growth. You'll be a generalist who gets in the weeds on all the business and operational aspects of a high-growth startup. In this role, you will:

 - Drive in-depth quantitative analyses to inform our pricing and packaging strategy.

 - Help spin up our deal desk and streamline enterprise deals.

 - Support the exec team on various finance functions, from investor relations to large cloud vendor negotiations to identifying cost optimization opportunities. 

 - Implement new tools and processes to enable the GTM org to grow rapidly.

 - Get creative on a spectrum of ad-hoc projects like securing new office space in Manhattan.




REQUIREMENTS:

We are looking for someone who:

 - Has 5+ years experience working in some kind of business function (e.g. banking, consulting, startup).

 - Has some exposure to tech and coding (in order to understand our product & customer, work with analytical tools, and build out custom tooling).

 - Is analytical, organized and detail-oriented, holds their output to a high bar of excellence.

 - Is eager to learn about a variety of different business functions and juggle many projects at once.

 - Is excited about working in-person in NYC.

THE ROLE:

We're looking for a Legal Operations Lead to join us as the first dedicated legal operations hire at Modal. You'll own the systems, records, and workflows that let a small legal team keep pace with a high-growth tech company — and you'll have an opportunity to build most of them from scratch.



This is a great fit for a highly organized, systems-oriented operator who thrives in a fast-paced environment and wants to build operational foundations, not just maintain them. You'll report to our General Counsel and collaborate closely with the Finance, BizOps, GTM, and People teams.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Build and maintain contract operations, including designing the contract lifecycle management workflows and approval logic, and continuing to iterate and improve those processes

 - Design legal intake process to support and route legal requests from internal stakeholders

 - Make the legal function faster with AI and build and configure tooling to make us more efficient

 - Manage corporate administration and record-keeping, including Board and stockholder matters, signature coordination, and building a knowledge management system and database

 - Be the point person for corporate compliance, including entity management and filings, including foreign and domestic qualifications and filings and coordinate with registered agents

 - Support stock administration and cap table hygiene

 - Manage outside counsel and legal spend




REQUIREMENTS:

 - 5+ years in legal operations, contract operations, or a corporate paralegal role, preferably at a high-growth technology company

 - Demonstrated ability to build and document processes from the ground up, not just execute existing ones

 - Experience configuring workflows and templates within Ironclad or a similar CLM

 - Experience with AI tools, and good instincts about where they help and where they quietly introduce risk

 - Sound judgment about what to handle and what to escalate




BONUS:

 - Exposure to corporate and equity administration; familiarity with Carta or a similar equity administration platform

We're looking for a People Operations Generalist to join our growing People team. You'll touch the employee lifecycle end-to-end — from offer acceptance through offboarding — while helping to build the processes and documentation that let our People function scale with the business.

 - Own and continuously improve the new hire onboarding experience, ensuring employees are set up for success and internal tasks are tracked and completed on time.

 - Maintain and improve self-service resources (FAQs, Notion pages, etc.) so employees can find what they need quickly — and always feel supported even when no one's in the room.

 - Support rollouts of new People programs and policies, including communication planning, manager enablement, and documentation.

 - Help bring employee experience programs and events to life, from team offsites to milestone recognition, that reinforce culture and make people feel valued.

 - Process employee changes (promotions, equity refreshes) accurately and on time, including preparing updated employment letters and maintaining compliant employee files.

 - 2+ years of People Operations experience, preferably at a high-growth startup.

Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g.,Seaborn https://github.com/mwaskom/seaborn,Luigi https://github.com/spotify/luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience.




THE ROLE:

We're hiring a Field Marketing Manager in San Francisco to build and run the programs that turn Modal's target accounts into active customers. You'll work closely with our Sales team to plan regional campaigns, run events for the engineers and technical leaders we sell to, and report on how those programs contribute to pipeline and revenue. This is a hands-on role for someone who has run account-based field programs at a technical company and wants to help shape the function as it grows.




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Act as a strategic partner to Sales, aligning field programs with sales priorities and helping AEs create and accelerate pipeline in their territories.

 - Develop and execute account-based programs for named accounts, working with Sales to identify key stakeholders and the right mix of touchpoints for each.

 - Decide which industry conferences and sponsorships are worth investing in. Own what we bring, who we send, and whether we go back next year.

 - Plan and host high-touch 1:1 and 1:few events for prospects and customers, such as executive dinners, roundtables, and technical workshops, in partnership with AEs.

 - Own pre-event and post-event execution, including targeted invitations, meeting booking, and timely follow-up with Sales.

 - Build co-marketing programs with VCs, accelerators, and ecosystem partners to reach their portfolio companies and customers.

 - Track and report on program performance, including meetings booked, account engagement, and sourced and influenced pipeline, and use the results to plan future investment.

 - Own the VIP experience at Modal's flagship events, including our annual conference, Runtime.

 - Build repeatable processes and playbooks as the team grows.
   


REQUIREMENTS:

 - A track record running field programs at a technical company. You can point to specific ones and clear outcomes.

 - You've worked directly with AEs and you're happy sharing a number with them.

 - Good judgment about where to spend. A lot of sponsorships look better than they perform, and you can tell which is which. Experience in AI or developer tools helps here.

 - Organized and self-directed. This role runs many events, partners, and vendors at once.

 - Experience producing events across a range of formats, from small executive dinners to large conference sponsorships and brand events.

 - Strong attention to detail and a high bar for taste and the quality of every event and touchpoint.

 - Comfort with data and reporting, including CRM, attribution, and pipeline analysis.

 - Familiarity with ABM, intent data, and marketing automation tools.

 - Experience building AI into marketing workflows, such as account research, audience development, event operations, and reporting.




NICE-TO-HAVE:

 - Experience at an AI, developer tools, or cloud infrastructure company.

 - Experience marketing to technical audiences such as engineers, ML teams, and technical executives.

 - Experience bridging product-led and sales-assisted growth.

 - Existing relationships with Bay Area VCs, accelerators, or AI communities.

The Role:

In short, the People Operations Generalist for the UK will own day-to-day People Operations for our growing UK team.

Reporting to our People Lead, Europe, you'll be the go-to person for UK employees and managers, with ownership across the employee lifecycle - from onboarding and payroll coordination to employee changes and offboarding. You'll bring strong UK People Operations expertise, help build scalable processes, and partner with the broader People team on global programs. You'll also help run the day-to-day London office and work closely with Recruiting on the final stages of the UK candidate experience, including onsite interview coordination and candidate support.

Things move fast at Modal, and priorities change as we grow. We're looking for someone flexible and hands-on who’s happy to jump in, figure things out, and take on whatever needs doing across their area. Some of the things you'll do:

 - Own day-to-day People Operations for our UK employees, including onboarding, employee changes, leave, documentation, and offboarding.

 - Act as the first point of contact for UK employees and managers, escalating more complex matters as needed.

 - Partner with payroll, benefits, pension, and other external providers to ensure smooth UK administration.

 - Keep employee data, documentation, and People processes accurate, compliant, and up to date.

 - Build and improve UK People processes, policies, and self-service resources as we scale.

 - Execute global People programs locally, ensuring they work effectively for our UK team.

 - Own day-to-day office operations in London, collaborating with internal partners (like the Workplace team!) and third party vendors.

 - Coordinate onsite interviews and the final stages of the candidate experience for UK hires.

 - Plan and support local employee events and initiatives.
   
   

What we're looking for:

 - 5+ years of People Operations or HR experience, ideally with experience at multiple fast-growing companies at a similar stage of growth.

 - Strong knowledge of UK People Operations and employment practices, including payroll, benefits, pensions, and employee lifecycle processes.

 - Comfortable working independently and taking ownership, with the judgment to know when to escalate or bring in additional expertise.

 - Highly organized and detail-oriented, comfortably managing multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a high level of discretion when handling sensitive employee matters.

 - A hands-on, flexible approach; you’re comfortable figuring things out, building processes from scratch, and jumping into whatever needs doing.

 - Experience with office operations, workplace, or recruiting coordination is a plus.

 - Based in London and comfortable working from the office five days a week (life happens, of course!)
